Mod.Name: Soldier 1st Ninostyle
Mod.Description:
A more accurate Soldier 1st outfit for Cloud when using Ninostyle chibi models.
3 Options to choose from: "Soldier 1st" Clouds iconic Soldier 1st outfit with no weapons shown. "Dynamic Weapons" Shows the equipped weapon on his back. "Buster sword" Show the Buster sword all times regardless of whats equipped.
NOTE:- Load Ninostyle Chibi mod, Shinra Archaeology cut and Advanced Facial Animation Fix after this.
